text: A muscular male figure, likely adult, with olive-brown skin. His hair is dark, shoulder-length, and straight. Face is broad with a prominent brow ridge and wide-set eyes. He wears minimal black loincloth. He crouches low, holding a spear with both hands, poised to strike or defend. Behind him stand two other figures: one taller, holding a spear; the other shorter, gripping a long staff. All appear tense, in a dimly lit cave setting with purple and blue rock textures.
